name: CaseTextIndentOffBox
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "text-indent-off-box" (text). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: text-indent: 9999px on a box pinned to 8px (the status-pip idiom: the label is pushed out of the box and only the dot shows)
